citations.claim: initial state at rest, zero force, so violation arises on first control step
first violating step: controller applied 83.44 force exceeding 64.18 limit, producing anomalous velocity
energy at violating step reflects excess controller work from over-limit force

counterfactual.change: set controller noise 0.2283 -> 0.0 only; clamped force becomes exactly fmax (64.18) and no violation, proving noise added outside/after force clamp causes overshoot

explanation: Velocity-error law demands force > fmax (clamped value is exactly fmax in noise-free run), but seeded sensor noise perturbation is added after/without clamping, pushing commanded force to 83.44 > 64.18 limit at step 1.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body starts well to the right of the green waypoint and shows essentially no movement between step 0 and step 1. There are no walls, collisions, or other bodies visible to explain an anomalous force.
